£200 to a Rolex by Christmas. Watch 15 is here.

This time I’m picking up a Tissot PRX 40mm with the ice blue dial.

The PRX is where this whole challenge started, so bringing another one into the journey feels very fitting. It is one of those watches that looks far more expensive than it is, and the ice blue dial gives it so much presence on the wrist.

As always though, the watch has to make sense as a trade too. Every buy, every sale and every bit of profit gets rolled straight into the next watch as we keep building towards the Rolex.

This is the part of the journey I enjoy most. Meeting sellers, checking the watch, agreeing the deal and seeing what comes next.

Watch 15 is now live for £450 with the full set at WatchSeason.co.uk.
